# kiln

> Agentic parametric-CAD platform: turn CadQuery code into verified,
> print-ready STLs, renders, instructions and BOMs. MCP-first: agents
> connect over remote MCP and bring their own model.

Status: P1 — cloud CAD builds are live. The MCP server (with server card
at /.well-known/mcp.json) arrives in phase P2. Live phase: GET /api/health.

## API (current)
- GET /api/health: Worker + bindings liveness (reports current phase)
- GET /api/engine/healthz: engine container + geometry stack versions
- POST /api/engine/measure: raw STL bytes -> extents/bounds/watertight
- POST /api/projects {slug, name, description?}: create project
- GET /api/projects | /api/projects/:slug: list / detail
- PUT /api/projects/:slug/source {path, content}: versioned CAD sources
- POST /api/projects/:slug/builds: run build (engine executes + verifies:
  watertight, bed-fit, support-free scan); artifacts to immutable R2 prefix
- GET /api/projects/:slug/builds/:id: status + verification report
- GET /api/projects/:slug/builds/:id/artifacts/<path>: download artifact

Note: requests with generic bot user agents may be challenged; send a
descriptive User-Agent.
